source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Whenever an enemy unit or this unit finishes a move, take each model of this unit that is up to 3" from 1 or more enemy units: pick 1 of those enemy units, destroy the model and roll a D6.

- 2-5: the picked unit takes D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)**
- 6: the picked unit takes D6 mortal wounds

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
